'''Thyrsian''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] people of the [[Thyrsian|same name]]. ''Nilo'', ''Xoni'', ''Quo'', and ''Kupe'' were Thyrsian for "Zero," "One," "Two," and "Three."
